programs.title: Crossing Over
programs.desc: This ensemble piece focuses on immigrants of different nationalities trying to achieve legal status in Los Angeles. It touches upon the issue at the border, document fraud, the asylum and green card process, work-site enforcement, naturalization, the office of counter terrorism and the clash of cultures.
